notes:
v4.6.25 — Local custom bots can RUN (no more 'Unknown bot' exit)

🐛 FIXED
• Running a custom bot LOCALLY (not via cloud) died with 'Unknown bot: <slug>' and exit code 2. Root cause: _run_bot in main.py only knew about LONG / SHORT / DAY / UNIVERSE side values. Any other slug fell through to the 'Unknown bot' branch.
• Now _run_bot looks up custom bots in DATA_DIR/bots/<slug>.py (and DATA_DIR/universe_scripts/<slug>.py, case-insensitive) and executes via runpy.run_path. Handles .apex (encrypted library) decryption on the fly.
• BotProcessWidget now passes the script_path as a CLI arg for ANY non-built-in side, not just UNIVERSE, so _run_bot resolves the right file without guessing.

Includes v4.6.24's Tools tab slot-dropdown refresh + v4.6.23's Make Bot worker hardening.
